ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: JoyoArto uses the microphone only while you record a voice note to add a transaction (up to 60 seconds). The recording is sent to JoyoArto's server to turn it into text and is then deleted, never stored.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: JoyoArto uses the camera only when you photograph a receipt to add a transaction. The photo is shrunk, read on JoyoArto's server and kept as proof in your household (you can delete it any time).
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: JoyoArto opens your photos only when you pick a receipt photo to add a transaction. Only the photo you pick is sent.
